blocked_by.reason: Corpus shows scaled-content fingerprints (32% self-noindexed, 66% template sentences, 100% identical updatedDate). Publishing new pages before cleanup W0-W4 is net-negative.

single_exception.rationale: Supports guides/saudi-rental-yield-guide (site's #2 page by impressions, 380 imp, pos 9.3) whose title promises Riyadh/Jeddah yields to foreign buyers; the Jan-2026 Saudi ownership law needs a fact-check pass.

strategy.problem: Corpus is saturated on conventional topics (all 12 buyer nationalities, 30 compare pages, 62 indexable yield pages, 18 Golden Visa pages). There is no topic gap.
strategy.thesis: Compete on content types a seller cannot publish: interactive tools, dated regulatory changelogs, primary data indexes, and risk/dispute/exit content.
strategy.competitor_weakness: All ranking pages carry a transaction incentive: no calculators, no downside content, no delivery-delay data, slow on regulatory change.
